title: Cost by agent and team
description: Per-agent and per-team AI spend from the gateway's OpenTelemetry spans (OpenLIT ClickHouse).

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.cost.total_cost'])) AS spend FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] IN ($team) AND coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) IN ($agent)

SELECT count() AS calls FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] IN ($team) AND coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) IN ($agent)

SELECT sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.total_tokens'])) AS tokens FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] IN ($team) AND coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) IN ($agent)

SELECT sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.cost.total_cost'])) / greatest(count(), 1) AS c FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] IN ($team) AND coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) IN ($agent)

SELECT quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e9 AS s FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] IN ($team) AND coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) IN ($agent)

SELECT countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS e FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] IN ($team) AND coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) IN ($agent)

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) AS agent, sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.cost.total_cost'])) AS spend FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] IN ($team) AND coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) IN ($agent) GROUP BY time, agent ORDER BY time

SELECT SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model, sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.cost.total_cost'])) AS spend FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] IN ($team) AND coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) IN ($agent) GROUP BY model ORDER BY spend DESC

SELECT SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] AS team, sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.cost.total_cost'])) AS spend FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] IN ($team) AND coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) IN ($agent) GROUP BY team ORDER BY spend DESC

SELECT coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) AS agent, SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] AS team, count() AS calls, sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.total_tokens'])) AS tokens, sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.cost.total_cost'])) AS spend, sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.cost.total_cost'])) / count() AS cost_per_call, quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e9 AS p95_latency_s, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS errors FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] IN ($team) AND coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) IN ($agent) GROUP BY agent, team ORDER BY spend DESC

panels.title: Most expensive runs (run_id from the agent)

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.requester_metadata'], '''run_id'': ''([^'']+)''') AS run_id, coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) AS agent, SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] AS team, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model, count() AS calls, sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.total_tokens'])) AS tokens, sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.cost.total_cost'])) AS spend FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'litellm_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_team_alias'] IN ($team) AND coalesce(nullIf(extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_auth_metadata'], '''agent_id'': ''([^'']+)'''), ''), SpanAttributes['metadata.user_api_key_alias']) IN ($agent) AND extract(SpanAttributes['metadata.requester_metadata'], '''run_id'': ''([^'']+)''') != '' GROUP BY run_id, agent, team, model ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 15
